scope: First twelve fixed index screening matrices, reproductions, focused checks and diagnostic profiles. All timings/outliers retained. This is investigation history, not final performance acceptance.

screens.purpose: First fixed-size performance screening of the index integrity implementation. All observations retained; acceptance still requires workspace gates and mixed ingestion/query comparisons.
Second fixed screening: checked B-tree read fast path and required per-file checksum identity; other measured writer/page costs intentionally unchanged.
Third fixed screening; only buffered writer changes relative to candidate2. Read parser and page geometry unchanged.
Fourth fixed screening: direct borrowed-slice decode after complete exact-extent preflight; buffered writer and page geometry unchanged from candidate3.
Fifth fixed screening: physical output buffer 8 KiB to 64 KiB only; integrity, page size and bitmap decoding unchanged from candidate4.
Sixth fixed screening: concrete bounded 64 KiB BTree serialization buffer before IndexWriter; all other production code unchanged from candidate5.
Seventh fixed screening: reuse per-file CRC prefix via Hasher clone. Encoding and page size unchanged; added ordinary dense-container serialization roundtrip is outside the performance fixture.

Eighth fixed screening: production candidate6 plus bounded header/first-page prefetch. Candidate7 prefix-reuse dropped for lack of demonstrated gain; its dense roundtrip test retained outside benchmark.
Ninth fixed screening: 1 KiB integrity pages and up to 16 KiB bounded footer cache, sized fallibly to actual footer extent. All other production behavior unchanged from candidate8.

Tenth fixed screening: reader range unions use MultiOps only for <=8 represented high16 row containers (<=64 KiB promoted payload), pairwise fallback otherwise; zero/one direct. All other production code unchanged from candidate9.

Eleventh fixed screening: full BTree loads use consuming read_all with one contiguous logical-data/footer read and complete per-page checks; small/raw reset and reuse Read. Random-probe geometry and bounded union unchanged.

Twelfth fixed screening: at1KiB page geometry, reuse exact file CRC prefix and combine page index/length into one16B suffix update. No encoding change; earlier4KiB prefix trial remains retained as rejected.

limitations: Screening includes only twelve write samples per revision/configuration; final acceptance needs more write samples and mixed node workloads.
Small first processes show substantial startup/cache/host variation, retained in aggregate results. Steady small build cost also remains above budget in these candidates.
